items.question: What excellent sacred destination in the eastern region should be visited next?
premises: The pilgrimage sequence continues from the previously named site.
The next destination is located in the eastern region.
Piṅgaleśvara is designated as an excellent sacred site.
items.inference: A pilgrim should proceed next to the excellent Piṅgaleśvara in the eastern region.
uncertainties: Whether pūrvabhāgaṃ specifies a directional region or functions as part of a place designation is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Then one should go to the excellent Piṅgaleśvara in the eastern region.
